independentSampleReview.reviewer: independent AI sample, not native speaker or teacher

entries.source: Save this code now. It is shown only once and you need it to sign in on other devices. Anyone who has it can act as you.
entries.translation: Stoor hierdie kode nou. Dit word net een keer gewys en jy benodig dit om op ander toestelle aan te meld. Enigiemand wat dit het, kan as jy optree.
entries.reason: Preserves one-time display, need on other devices, and possession enabling impersonation/account actions.

entries.source: Your application stays pending until our staff approve it. You can take requests only after approval.
entries.translation: Jou aansoek bly hangende totdat ons personeel dit goedkeur. Jy kan eers ná goedkeuring versoeke aanvaar.
entries.reason: Preserves pending status and approval prerequisite for accepting requests.

entries.source: Translation unavailable. The original text is shown.
entries.translation: Vertaling onbeskikbaar. Die oorspronklike teks word gewys.
entries.reason: Preserves unavailable translation and showing original text.

entries.source: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your request was NOT sent.
entries.translation: Die diens is tydelik onbeskikbaar. Jou versoek is NIE gestuur nie.
entries.reason: Preserves temporary unavailability and emphatic NOT sent.

entries.source: Your request is saved. No helper is available for it right now; it stays open, and a helper who becomes available can still take it.
entries.translation: Jou versoek is gestoor. Geen helper is tans daarvoor beskikbaar nie; dit bly oop en 'n helper wat beskikbaar word, kan dit steeds aanvaar.
entries.reason: Preserves saved/open request and possibility of a later available helper accepting.

entries.source: Your request is saved on our server. Helpers who can take it are notified. Your text is delivered as you wrote it, with a machine translation when one is available.
entries.translation: Jou versoek is op ons bediener gestoor. Helpers wat dit kan aanvaar, word in kennis gestel. Jou teks word afgelewer soos jy dit geskryf het, met 'n masjienvertaling waar beskikbaar.
entries.reason: Preserves server storage, notification to eligible helpers, original text delivery, and conditional machine translation.

entries.source: This weekly schedule is only your own note on this device. Requests reach you based on your approval, the "available" switch, your services and your areas, which are kept on the server.
entries.translation: Hierdie weeklikse skedule is net jou eie nota op hierdie toestel. Versoeke bereik jou op grond van jou goedkeuring, die “beskikbaar”-skakelaar, jou dienste en jou gebiede, wat op die bediener gestoor word.
entries.reason: Preserves device-only schedule note and server-held matching criteria.

entries.source: Your account is paused by staff. You cannot take requests until it is reinstated.
entries.translation: Jou rekening is deur personeel onderbreek. Jy kan nie versoeke aanvaar voordat dit herstel is nie.
entries.reason: Preserves staff-imposed suspension and restoration prerequisite.

entries.source: We do not ask for your phone number. You talk to your helper in a 1:1 chat on this website.
entries.translation: Ons vra nie jou telefoonnommer nie. Jy praat met jou helper in 'n 1:1-klets op hierdie webwerf.
entries.reason: Preserves no phone-number request and website 1:1 chat.

entries.source: Keep this link to open your request on another device.
entries.translation: Bewaar hierdie skakel om jou versoek op 'n ander toestel oop te maak.
entries.reason: Preserves link retention for opening request on another device.

entries.source: Save this code now. It is shown only once and you need it to sign in on other devices. Anyone who has it can act as you.
entries.translation: I-save ang code na ito ngayon. Isang beses lang itong ipinapakita at kailangan mo ito para mag-sign in sa ibang device. Maaaring magpanggap na ikaw ang sinumang mayroon nito.
entries.reason: Preserves one-time display, need on other devices, and possession enabling impersonation/account actions.

entries.source: Your application stays pending until our staff approve it. You can take requests only after approval.
entries.translation: Mananatiling naghihintay ang aplikasyon mo hanggang aprubahan ng aming kawani. Pagkatapos lang ng pag-apruba ka maaaring tumanggap ng kahilingan.
entries.reason: Preserves pending status and approval prerequisite for accepting requests.

entries.source: Translation unavailable. The original text is shown.
entries.translation: Walang salin na magagamit. Ipinapakita ang orihinal na teksto.
entries.reason: Preserves unavailable translation and showing original text.

entries.source: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your request was NOT sent.
entries.translation: Pansamantalang hindi magagamit ang serbisyo. HINDI naipadala ang kahilingan mo.
entries.reason: Preserves temporary unavailability and emphatic NOT sent.

entries.source: Your request is saved. No helper is available for it right now; it stays open, and a helper who becomes available can still take it.
entries.translation: Na-save ang kahilingan mo. Walang available na helper para rito ngayon; mananatili itong bukas at maaari pa ring tanggapin ng helper na magiging available.
entries.reason: Preserves saved/open request and possibility of a later available helper accepting.

entries.source: Your request is saved on our server. Helpers who can take it are notified. Your text is delivered as you wrote it, with a machine translation when one is available.
entries.translation: Naka-save ang kahilingan mo sa aming server. Inaabisuhan ang mga helper na kayang tumanggap nito. Ihahatid ang teksto mo ayon sa pagkakasulat mo, kasama ang salin ng makina kung mayroon.
entries.reason: Preserves server storage, notification to eligible helpers, original text delivery, and conditional machine translation.

entries.source: This weekly schedule is only your own note on this device. Requests reach you based on your approval, the "available" switch, your services and your areas, which are kept on the server.
entries.translation: Sarili mong tala sa device na ito lamang ang lingguhang iskedyul. Dumarating ang mga kahilingan batay sa iyong pag-apruba, switch na “available”, mga serbisyo at lugar, na nakatago sa server.
entries.reason: Main device/server distinction is retained. “Nakatago” can mean hidden; “nakaimbak” would more clearly mean stored. “Iyong pag-apruba” may imply approval given by the helper instead of approved status; prefer “pagkakaapruba sa iyo”.

entries.source: Your account is paused by staff. You cannot take requests until it is reinstated.
entries.translation: Pinahinto ng kawani ang account mo. Hindi ka makakatanggap ng kahilingan hanggang maibalik ito.
entries.reason: Suspension and restoration are retained, but “makakatanggap” can mean receive rather than accept. A native reviewer should consider “makakakuha o makakatanggap ng trabaho” or “makakapag-accept ng kahilingan” in this UI context.

entries.source: We do not ask for your phone number. You talk to your helper in a 1:1 chat on this website.
entries.translation: Hindi namin hinihingi ang numero mo ng telepono. Makakausap mo ang helper sa 1:1 chat sa website na ito.
entries.reason: Preserves no phone-number request and website 1:1 chat.

entries.source: Keep this link to open your request on another device.
entries.translation: Itago ang link na ito para mabuksan ang kahilingan sa ibang device.
entries.reason: Preserves link retention for opening request on another device.
